calls.title: Sr Product Designer Interview - Chris
calls.summary: The team presented a significant redesign of the legacy CPQ platform aimed at improving usability and supporting new customer acquisition. Key enhancements included a new drawer interface to streamline workflows and reduce loading times, alongside customizing features for flexibility. A unified visual system based on Material Design was established to ensure brand consistency across related pricing products. Close collaboration with international engineering teams was emphasized, with regular meetings and communication to align design with technical capabilities. The approach of rapid prototyping and early stakeholder engagement was adopted to deliver visible progress. The project navigated legacy backend constraints creatively, focusing on user interface improvements without extensive backend changes, highlighting an evolving design role that incorporates project management responsibilities.
calls.keywords: CPQ platform, product design, SaaS transformation, user experience (UX), engineering collaboration, startup design roles
